message.reasoning_content: Round 6 action, then market. I have cash 31.5M, president, influence 2. Shuttle gives 3 goods but risk; produce gives 2 goods. Market prices: sold_counter 6, ladder starts at 7. Selling 2-3 units at ~7 each = ~14-21 alashi. Shuttle EV = 3*7*0.75 = 15.75 minus risk; produce = 2*7 = 14. Shuttle better, but confiscation loses goods... Actually produce safest, but shuttle slightly better EV. No tariff protection, no preferential border mentioned. Take shuttle.
